common.tagline: Read your way to a new language

uiLanguage.label: Interface language
uiLanguage.title: Interface language
uiLanguage.description: The language of buttons, menus, book titles and descriptions. Translations and explanations use the translation language below.
uiLanguage.alsoNative: Also use {language} for translations and book titles?
uiLanguage.alsoNativeFailed: Could not change the translation language

login.title: Sign in
login.deleted: Your account and all of its data have been permanently deleted.
login.unverified: {email} hasn't been verified yet. Check your inbox for the link.
login.resent: Verification email sent — check your inbox.

register.title: Create your account
register.name: Name
register.passwordHint: Use 8 or more characters with a letter and a digit.
register.checkBody: We sent a verification link to {email}. Click it to activate your account, then sign in.
register.errMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
register.errWeak: Choose a stronger password: at least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
register.errEmailDisposable: Temporary email addresses can't be used. Please use your usual email.
register.errEmailAlias: An account already uses this email address in another form. Sign in with that address instead.

reset.expiredBody: That reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.
reset.checkBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a reset link.
reset.passwordHint: Use 8 or more characters with a letter and a digit.
reset.updated: Password updated — sign in with the new one.
reset.errMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.errWeak: Choose a stronger password: at least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.introBackup: Enter one of your backup codes. Each code works once.
twoFactor.introTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.errExpired: This sign-in attempt has expired — enter your password again.
twoFactor.errLocked: Too many failed codes — wait a bit, then sign in again.
twoFactor.errTotp: That code didn't work — try the current one.

setup.intro: Tell us just enough to choose a useful first lesson. Every answer is optional.
setup.personaliseHint: We use it to show free books at the right difficulty first.
setup.readyHint: The guide stays inside a real starter lesson and can be left at any time.
setup.levelHint: You can change it later in Free books.
setup.nativeHint: Translations and explanations use this language. The interface is available in English and Simplified Chinese.
setup.interestsHint: Optional — we'll add fresh articles on these topics to Free books.
setup.recommendIntro: Based on your level ({level}) and interests. Choose one and we will walk you through your first reading.

landing.metaTitle: Readfox – read real books in the language you are learning
landing.metaDescription: Import a book or paste any text, tap a word for an instant translation, and turn what you read into spaced-repetition practice. Free and open source.
landing.heroTitle: Read real books in the language you are learning
landing.heroBody: Readfox turns reading into learning. Tap any word for a translation, collect vocabulary as you go, and practise it with spaced repetition. {count} languages, free to use.
landing.heroAlt: Readfox: a fox resting on an open book

read.title: Read what you love
read.body: Import an EPUB or paste any text. Your own books become your lessons.

tap.title: Tap a word, understand it
tap.body: Instant translations and explanations in context, from a built-in monthly allowance. Paid plans can also use your own AI key.

vocab.title: Your vocabulary builds itself
vocab.body: Every word you look up is saved with the sentence you found it in.

srs.title: Spaced-repetition practice
srs.body: Review words at the right moment so they actually stick.

write.title: Write and get feedback
write.body: Keep a journal in your target language and have it corrected.

landing.openTitle: Open source, and your reading stays yours
landing.openBody: Readfox is open-source software (AGPL-3.0), built on the open-source reader Lector. AI features include a limited monthly allowance. We do not run advertising or analytics trackers. Read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

nativeLanguage.title: Translation language
nativeLanguage.description: Word meanings, explanations, tutor replies and journal feedback are written in this language. It can differ from the interface language, for example a Chinese interface with English explanations. Built-in dictionary entries stay in English.
nativeLanguage.sameAsLearning: You are learning {language}, the same language. Pick another translation language to get useful explanations.

languagePrefs.title: Interface and translation languages
languagePrefs.hint: These are two separate choices. For example, you can use a Chinese interface and read explanations in English while you learn French.
